content.text:
**Close the reset finding: 0064 fixes the reproduced defect, and 0063’s pulse-offset correction passes focused verification. I found no remaining material blocker in these changes.**

- **Reset ownership:** [m_clock.lua:684](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/m_clock.lua:684) preserves continuous value, remaps the destination occurrence from the reset range’s first step, and silently retires out-of-range targets. I reproduced **18 emissions, zero failures**, versus the retained baseline’s nine failures. Additional in-memory checks passed for an immediate destination, a non-1 range start, and silent out-of-range retirement.
- **Transition ordering:** [step.lua:956](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/step.lua:956) cancels only when the selected pattern changes, before new-pattern timing updates and channel callbacks. Same-pattern wraps survive. The production reset runs at clock order 1, before channels at order 2; consequently, the retained `last_processed_transport` cannot incorrectly add a pulse on this path.
- **Projection:** [m_lattice.lua:618](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/clock/m_lattice.lua:618) accounts for channels already processed within the current pulse. I reran **21,336 successful occurrence comparisons**, including one-pulse clocks and between-pulse queries.
- **Evidence:** Both [reset report](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-runs/slide-reset-native/report.json) and [song-cutoff report](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-runs/slide-song-cutoff-native/report.json) contain completed baseline failures and real-time candidate passes; controlled candidates also passed. Their clock/lattice/step hashes match current source. The [native oracles](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/patch_params.py:390) use literal timing and captured MIDI, including an unowned first reset step and silence before the new pattern’s lock. The retained **484-unit pass** also matches current source hashes.

**CONFIDENCE: High** within this scope; lifecycle, Off/trigless, repeated-edit, and full manual/emulator coverage remain incomplete, so this does not certify release or refactoring readiness.
